parameter_semantics: No high-level parameters. Each represented target is relative to the measured TCP immediately before its action; decoding resolves the fresh measured TCP and joints. Two causal frames are oldest first, with only initial-episode duplication allowed.
output_semantics: Each slot is [current-TCP-frame translation xyz in metres, current-TCP-frame rotation vector xyz in radians, native gripper scalar]. Training uses inverse(T_world_tcp_before_action) times the demonstrated commanded TCP pose. Decode left-composes the relative transform with the fresh measured world TCP pose, then calls panda_kinematics.solve_ik from fresh qpos. Slots are t-1 through t+14; execution uses slots 1 through 8. Gripper >=0 opens and <0 closes.

conversion_check.description: Round-trip each demonstrated commanded TCP through the current-TCP relative SE(3) transform, then compare decoded-joint FK position and rotation and the gripper scalar. IK residual and limit diagnostics remain visible.

cut_relation: Every assigned [740,1270) action remains supervised in all twelve occurrences, including incoming [740,950) and outgoing [1120,1270) overlaps. The local Cartesian representation changes coordinates, not responsibility, labels, timing, or success criteria.
